An '''Enforcer Battle Group''' was a military formation of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. An Enforcer Battle Group was landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]] and took control of twenty-five percent of the world.
